echo "=== Health-checking source environment ==="
echo "Target: http://{{workflow.parameters.service-name}}.{{workflow.parameters.source-namespace}}:{{workflow.parameters.app-port}}{{workflow.parameters.openapi-endpoint}}"
ATTEMPTS=0
MAX_ATTEMPTS=60
while [ $ATTEMPTS -lt $MAX_ATTEMPTS ]; do
  ATTEMPTS=$((ATTEMPTS + 1))
  HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
    "http://{{workflow.parameters.service-name}}.{{workflow.parameters.source-namespace}}:{{workflow.parameters.app-port}}{{workflow.parameters.openapi-endpoint}}" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
  if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    echo "Source environment is ready (attempt $ATTEMPTS)"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "Attempt $ATTEMPTS/$MAX_ATTEMPTS -- HTTP $HTTP_CODE, retrying in 5s..."
  sleep 5
done
echo "ERROR: Source environment not ready after 5 minutes"
exit 1
